tool_calls.args_summary: report_id=FR_0001, summary=Fraud report FR_0001: Rs 85,000 stolen from victim Ravi Kumar (ACC_0461) via fake KYC verification call. Funds flowed ACC_0461 -> ACC_0462 (Suresh Reddy, SBI, emptied) -> split into two branches: (a) ACC_0463 (Priya Iyer, Axis Bank) holding Rs 40,000 with fan-out split and shared-device link signals; (b) ACC_0464 (Anil Nair, ICICI) -> ACC_0465 (Kavya Sharma, Kotak) -> ACC_0466 (Rohit Mehta, Bank of Baroda) holding Rs 15,000 with rapid-forwarding signals; Rs 28,000 already cashed out at ACC_0466. Total recoverable: Rs 57,000. No prior cases found for these accounts. Freeze recommendation (for human review): ACC_0463 (priority 1, Rs 40,000) and ACC_0466 (priority 2, Rs 15,000). ACC_0462 rejected (already emptied)., account_ids=[2 items]
